sources.note: Inspected owner-supplied del-rosario-high-school.png on 2026-10-08; capture date unknown. URL locates the site. Northern green patch bordered by broad crowns, south/west/east canopy chains and courtyard-side plants; exposed north-of-classroom apron links remain open. The northern greenery stops at the separate elementary parent and crop boundary; no surveyed extent or hedge inferred. Tentative long green roof match; separate reference and source footprint do not imply shared grounds with the elementary school. Corrected the southwest check to the partially visible lower blue roof; the pale upper-left roof is outside this matched source neighborhood. Independent excluded check errors: 2.64 m, 3.26 m. Visible crown centers are fitted to clear trunks within the observed crown footprint (maximum seven metres); crowns may overhang roofs and roads. Crown widths in the dense belts are estimated from image pixels against their matched local roof scale; existing circular crowns approximate irregular/elliptical image crowns. Complete mapped roofs, pitches, full-width paths/roads, water and farmland remain unchanged. Planted islands take precedence over exposed paving; ground under opaque canopy is not invented. No surveyed boundary, species, construction date or exact inventory inferred; no bitmap ships. Owner grass correction (2026-10-08): The upper smooth green opening is low cover but falls outside the complete preserved source parent under the unchanged registration; that omission remains a parcel limit, not a claim of no grass. Add only exposed lower/west grass pockets inside the parent, excluding raised tree crowns, roofs and hard apron. Remaining mixed foliage/shadows are ambiguous draft observations. Classification uses texture, form and context, including dry turf, rather than green hue alone. Added ground excludes opaque observed crowns; original tree positions, routes and registration remain unchanged.
